versions.changelog:
Skill updated to support agent shopping on Amazon with enhanced security and approval features.

- Agents can now shop on Amazon using guardrailed wallets and require owner approval for transactions.
- Multiple payment rails supported: Encrypted Card (default), Stripe Wallet (x402), and Crossmint Wallet (Coming Soon).
- Detailed security measures implemented, including encrypted card handling, strict API key usage, and owner-configurable spending permissions.
- Extensive documentation provided for setup, management, and file access.
- Owners maintain full control and oversight of agent spending with real-time logs, approval modes, and wallet freezing capabilities.
